LWQnoRS: the lean recipe -- no digit block, centred windows replacing the shape encoder, quantisation ladder, freq block, dual TE, R0 hyperparameters -- with fe_recipe_score OFF. OOF 0.946048 at 50 features, against the champion WQ2's 0.946080 at 154. THE JOB: close tonight's feature-bulk series at its low end. The series is now WQ2 154 / WR 175 / WD 194 at 0.94631 / 0.94633 / 0.94633, with corr(n_features, residual) = +0.75 -- the OPPOSITE sign from what bulk predicts, on a pair (WQ2 vs WR) whose OOF matches to all six decimals. This point extends the span to 144 features with fe_recipe_score held off on both ends and hyperparameters identical, breaking both confounds that made Phase 16 section 3's W2-vs-LW comparison unreadable. PRE-REGISTERED: raw pred 0.94636. The rs-free rich runs average residual -0.00007, which predicts 0.94629; a bulk effect of the size Phase 16 originally fitted predicts ~0.94636. Landing at 0.94629 confirms the refutation and closes feature bulk for good; landing at 0.94636 resurrects it and makes dropping the digit block the next champion move. SECONDARY: rs removal is OOF-neutral here (+0.000002 vs LWQ's 0.946046) whereas W2RS measured it at -0.000160 on the lean E1-params base -- so the displacement mechanism tracks hyperparameters, not feature count alone.

WR: WQnoRS with te_window_radii densified from six values [2,5,10,25,50,200] to eleven [1,2,3,5,8,12,20,35,60,120,250]. OOF 0.946080, -0.000004 vs WQnoRS -- a DEAD NULL, one tenth of the seed floor, at 175 features. The window encoder's radii were a first guess from Phase 16 and had never been probed; nearly doubling the ladder and widening both ends buys nothing. MECHANISM, and it corrects a Phase 16 explanation: Phase 15's X1 found the SHAPE encoder flat from 1024 to 16384 bins, and Phase 16 explained that null away as the arbitrary-origin defect being shared by every setting tried, implying a correctly-centred encoder would show real sensitivity to its pooling scale. It does not. Neighbour-pooling granularity is flat in general, not flat because the grid was broken -- so X1's null was a property of the pooling, and Phase 16's account of it was wrong. THE REASON THIS GETS A SLOT: WR's OOF matches WQ2's 0.946080 to all six decimals while carrying 175 features against WQ2's 154, with identical hyperparameters and fe_recipe_score off on both sides. That is a perfectly OOF-matched pair differing ONLY in feature count -- the cleanest feature-bulk test this competition has produced, better than the W2-vs-LW pair Phase 16 section 3 used (confounded by hyperparameters and rs at once) and better than tonight's other contrasts. PRE-REGISTERED: WQ2 scored 0.94631. Bulk predicts WR ~0.94628; no bulk predicts 0.94631. WD (194 feats, residual -0.00003, the BEST of the night) already points against bulk.

WD: WQnoRS + te_window_sides -- left/right window rates plus slope and curvature, the derivative channels the centred-window encoder dropped when it superseded the fixed-grid shape encoder. OOF 0.946049, -0.000035 vs WQnoRS, at 194 features. THE HYPOTHESIS IS REFUTED, and consistently: the same ingredient measures -0.000035 here (rich base, R0 params, 194 feats), -0.000041 as WDS (sides WITH the shape encoder dropped, 178 feats) and -0.000043 as W2D (lean base, E1 params, 62 feats) -- three structurally different bases, one answer, all just above the 0.000038 seed floor. best_iter is normal throughout (988-1494), so this is not displacement in the F1/H2/H3/P3 sense; the derivative channels are simply redundant with what six centred radii already encode. Phase 14's attribution of the shape encoder's gain to its slope/curvature channels does not survive re-parameterisation: what the window encoder kept (correct centring) was the part that mattered, and what it dropped was not. TWO JOBS: this is also the fifth deliberately-worse-model check (after H2, L1, R2, G5) and the widest rich-side feature contrast available tonight -- 194 features against WQ2's 154 at an OOF gap of only 0.000031. Raw pred 0.94636. Bulk predicts ~0.94626; no bulk predicts ~0.94628.

WQ2: the champion WQnoRS with the fixed-grid shape encoder DROPPED (te_shape_cols empty). OOF 0.946080 vs 0.946084 -- a DEAD NULL (-0.000004, one tenth of the seed floor), at 154 features against 170. Phase 16 section 1 declared te_shape_cols superseded by the centred-window encoder and said it 'should not appear in new recipes', but it has ridden along in every champion since R0 and was never tested on WQ's own representation; WS beat W1 by +0.000016 on a base without the quantisation ladder, and that small gain does NOT reproduce here -- it is a wash, so the encoder is redundant rather than harmful. The practical result either way is that the champion sheds 16 features for free. PRE-REGISTERED: raw GBDT-fit pred 0.94640. Against WQnoRS's own 0.94629 at essentially identical OOF, this is a near-twin pair (resolution 0.000027) differing ONLY in feature count, with hyperparameters, fe_recipe_score and every other knob held fixed -- the clean version of the feature-bulk test Phase 16 section 3 raised and abandoned on the W2-vs-LW pair, which was confounded by hyperparameters AND rs at once. 16 features is a narrow contrast (bulk predicts only ~0.00002), so this point is read together with LWQnoRS at 50 features, not alone. >=0.94632 leans bulk; <=0.94626 leans against.

WQnoRS: the champion WQ (OOF 0.946086, LB 0.94624) with fe_recipe_score OFF. OOF 0.946084 -- a DEAD NULL (-0.000002), so this is a near-twin pair (resolution 0.000027) and any LB movement is pure residual offset, not model quality. Cross-tab of all 18 submitted runs separates PERFECTLY on this one flag: rs=True (R0,R1,R2,W1,WS,WQ,LW,LWcap7,LWlr05,G2,G5,E4r0,X4,W2FB,W2RS) mean residual -0.00016; rs=False (S1,W2,W2TM) mean -0.00000. But every rs-free run is LEAN (32-41 feats) and every rich run carries rs, so the two are perfectly confounded -- this is the one untested cell: rs-free at 170 features. Phase 17 declined this slot arguing displacement cannot operate at 172 feats; that argument is about OOF, and the question is about the LB residual. Raw GBDT-fit pred 0.94640. PRE-REGISTERED: >=0.94634 => fe_recipe_score carries the offset, struck from every recipe, champion moves, 15 runs' residuals re-priced. <=0.94627 => Phase 17's exemption holds, the offset is diffuse. 0.00016 apart = ~6 sigma on one slot.
